records.question: Bill is hoarding toilet paper in fear of another pandemic. Bill goes to the bathroom three times a day and uses 5 squares of toilet paper each time. If Bill has 1000 rolls of toilet paper and each roll has 300 squares of toilet paper, how many days will his toilet paper supply last?
records.response:
Bill uses 3*5=15 squares of toilet paper per day.
Bill has 1000*300=300000 squares of toilet paper.
The toilet paper supply will last 300000/15=20000 days.
#### 20000

records.response:
Each time Bill goes to the bathroom, he uses 5 squares of toilet paper. Therefore, in a day, he uses 5 * 3 = 15 squares of toilet paper.
If each roll has 300 squares of toilet paper, then Bill can use 300 / 15 = 20 rolls of toilet paper per day.
If Bill has 1000 rolls of toilet paper, then his supply will last 1000 / 20 = 50 days.
#### 50

records.question: Hakeem has always loved artichoke dip and plans to make it this weekend. He has $15 dollars to buy artichokes and can find the rest of the ingredients at home. It takes 3 artichokes to make 5 ounces of dip. How many ounces can he make if artichokes cost $1.25 each?
records.response:
Hakeem can buy 15/1.25 = 12 artichokes.
Hakeem can make 12*5/3 = 20 ounces of dip.
#### 20
